findings.current_behavior: POST /api/orders/[orderId]/print queues order for w4 without validating shipping_address exists
findings.issue: Orders without shipping_address can be queued for w4, which will fail when w4 tries to submit to Lulu
findings.fix: Add validation check: if (!order.shipping_address || !order.shipping_address.address || !order.shipping_address.city) throw error preventing queue. Return clear error message: 'Order cannot be sent to print fulfillment: shipping information not yet available. Please upload CSV to populate customer data.'

findings.issue: Zod validation will reject orders with null/undefined shipping_address, causing createOrder() to throw validation error
findings.fix: Validation is correct - this will prevent invalid orders from reaching Lulu. Ensure callers check shipping_address before calling PODService.createOrder()

notes.primary_fix: Add shipping_address validation to POST /api/orders/[orderId]/print route to prevent orders without customer data from being queued for w4
